Hello everyone!

I’m a polyglot (fluent in 7 languages and currently studying other 2) and certified foreign languages teacher from Barcelona. Learning and teaching has always been my passion as well as my job because I think there’s always room for improvement and practice makes perfect. I have experience in language academies, banks, schools, companies, groups of all ages and one-to-one tuitions.

My method or 10 key points to success:

. Pre-Assessment of your level, strengths and weaknesses in your first lesson and Continuous Assessment to verify your improvements in every lesson.

. Encouraging, comfortable and friendly atmosphere with an extremely supportive teacher.

. Selected materials and tailor-made lessons to cover your needs.

. Developing multiple skills in every lesson: reading, writing, speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation.

. Enhancing learner’s autonomy by developing healthy study routines, time management, memorizing techniques and ways to continue practicing after our lesson.

. Authentic materials and course tasks to replicate real communication and situations, always with a guided and structured conversation.

. A language focus part in every lesson (grammar or vocabulary) is fundamental, because accuracy is as important as fluency.

. Discovering and reflecting about the target-language culture - a basic part of learning a new language.

. Organization and planning while setting your goals at the beginning of your language-learning adventure.

. Constant feedback between student and teacher concerning difficulties, needs, etc.

What I offer:

. General language lessons for those willing to improve at 360°.

. Test preparation for those wanting to get a certification.

. Conversation lessons to maintain your level and achieve fluency. 

. Business lessons for professionals to perform efficiently in the target language.

. The Polyglot Experience - having a conversation in multiple lang, constantly switching.

In our lessons, I will ALWAYS correct you, by writing down or interrupting to tell you this was mispronounced, grammatically incorrect or if it doesn’t sound right or natural.
I have experience in teaching non-native Arabic speakers. I have taught many students and they all loved the language.
I can teach children and adults in a simple and uncomplicated way. 
I am patient and friendly. I am flexible, I don't have a problem if a student asks me to change the topic or reschedule

We can translate also. I will give you a text to translate and correct it together. I can also give homework to the student to prepare on their own and then we can review it.
